help_menu.en:
Here are the commands you can use:

/start - Begin or restart the course
/next - Move to the next lesson
/quiz - Take the quiz for the current module
/progress - Check your current module and lesson
/language - Change your language
/menu - View course outline
/help - Show this help message
help_menu.pcm:
Na these commands you fit use:

/start - Begin or restart the course
/next - Go to the next lesson
/quiz - Do quiz for this module
/progress - Check where you dey now
/language - Change your language
/menu - See course outline
/help - Show this help message
help_menu.ha:
Ga nan umarnin da kake iya amfani:

/start - Fara ko maimaita jerin
/next - Wuce ga jerin na gida
/quiz - Yi quiz na modul na yanzu
/progress - Dubi modul da jerin na yanzu
/language - Canja harshek
/menu - Dubi firafen jerin
/help - Nuna sanarwar mai taimakon
help_menu.yo:
Eyi ni awọn aṣayan ti o le lo:

/start - Bẹrẹ tabi tun bẹrẹ eko naa
/next - Lo si eko atẹle
/quiz - Ṣe idinku fun modul lọwọlọwọ
/progress - Yaworan modul ati eko lọwọlọwọ
/language - Yi ede naa
/menu - Wo ọkọ eko naa
/help - Fihan ifiranṣẹ iranlọwọ
help_menu.ig:
Ndị bụ onyonyo ị nwere ike iji:

/start - Malite ma ọ bụ malite ọzọ akwukwo
/next - Gaa na akwukwo ọzọ
/quiz - Eme ajụjụ maka modul ugbu a
/progress - Lelee modul na akwukwo ugbu a
/language - Gbanwe asụsụ gị
/menu - Lelee ụkpụrụ akwukwo
/help - Igosi ozi inyere

lessons_complete.en:
✅ You've completed all lessons in "{module_title}"!

Time for a quick quiz to test your knowledge. Type /quiz to begin.
lessons_complete.pcm:
✅ You don finish all the lessons for "{module_title}"!

Time to do small quiz. Type /quiz to start.
lessons_complete.ha:
✅ Ka gama jerin duka a cikin "{module_title}"!

Lokacin gaida quiz don gwada iliminka. Kunna /quiz don fara.
lessons_complete.yo:
✅ Ẹ ti parí gbogbo eko ninu "{module_title}"!

Akoko fun idinku kekere lati lo imọ yin. Kunna /quiz lati bẹrẹ.
lessons_complete.ig:
✅ Ị gachasịla akwukwo nile na "{module_title}"!

Ogbe maka ajụjụ mma maka ịmụta gị. Kunna /quiz iji malite.

quiz_not_completed.en:
You need to complete the quiz for "{module_title}" before moving on.

Type /quiz to take the quiz.
quiz_not_completed.pcm:
You need to finish the quiz for "{module_title}" before you fit move.

Type /quiz to do the quiz.
quiz_not_completed.ha:
Kana bukatar gama quiz na "{module_title}" kafin mu ci gaba.

Kunna /quiz don yin quiz.
quiz_not_completed.yo:
Ẹ nilo lati parí idinku fun "{module_title}" ṣaaju ki ẹ lọ siwaju.

Kunna /quiz lati ṣe idinku.
quiz_not_completed.ig:
Ị nwere ike ịrụchasi ajụjụ maka "{module_title}" tupu ị gaa n'ihu.

Biko kunna /quiz iji ṣee ajụjụ.

quiz_correct.en:
"Ehen!" Correct! 🎉 That's the right answer!

You've passed the quiz for this module. Type /next to continue your learning journey.
quiz_correct.pcm:
"Ehen!" Correct! 🎉 Na the right answer be that!

You don pass the quiz for this module. Type /next to continue.
quiz_correct.ha:
"Haba!" Daidai! 🎉 Wannan shine amsar daidai!

Ka saukar da quiz na wannan modul. Kunna /next don ci gaba da jerin ilimi.
quiz_correct.yo:
"Daadiiu!" O tọ! 🎉 Iyẹn ni idahon ti o tọ!

Ẽ ti redi fun idinku fun modul yii. Kunna /next lati tẹsiwaju ẹkọ yin.
quiz_correct.ig:
"Mma!" Ziri! 🎉 Ọ bụ azịza ziri!

Ị gachasịla ajụjụ maka modul a. Kunna /next iji gaa n'ihu.

quiz_incorrect.en:
"Chai!" Not quite right. The correct answer was {correct_answer}.

Don't worry — learning is a journey! Type /quiz to retry.
quiz_incorrect.pcm:
"Chai!" E no correct. The right answer na {correct_answer}.

No worry — learning na journey! Type /quiz to try again.
quiz_incorrect.ha:
"Chai!" Ba daidai ba. Amsar daidai ta ji {correct_answer}.

Kada ku damuwa — ilimi shi jira! Kunna /quiz don sake yin.
quiz_incorrect.yo:
"Aye!" Kò tọ daidai. Idahon ti o tọ ni {correct_answer}.

Ku maarun — ẹkọ ni orin! Kunna /quiz lati bã tun ṣe.
quiz_incorrect.ig:
"Ehé!" Ọ naghị ziri. Azịza ziri bụ {correct_answer}.

Kadụ na-eche iwe — ịmụta bụ njem! Kunna /quiz iji ṣee ọzọ.

quiz_already_completed.en: You have already completed the quiz for this module. Type /next to continue.
quiz_already_completed.pcm: You don already do the quiz for this module. Type /next to continue.
quiz_already_completed.ha: Ka gama quiz na wannan modul. Kunna /next don ci gaba.
quiz_already_completed.yo: Ẹ ti parí idinku fun modul yii. Kunna /next lati tẹsiwaju.
quiz_already_completed.ig: Ị gachasịla ajụjụ maka modul a. Kunna /next iji gaa n'ihu.

course_complete.en:
🎉 Congratulations! You have completed all available lessons and quizzes!

You are now a champion for positive masculinity and GBV prevention.

Type /progress to review your achievement or /start to retake the course.
course_complete.pcm:
🎉 Congrats! You don finish all the lessons and quizzes!

You be champion now for positive masculinity and GBV prevention.

Type /progress to check your achievement or /start to do the course again.
course_complete.ha:
🎉 Kumatti! Ka gama jerin da quiz duka!

Kunna champion na musulunci mai kyau da kawar GBV.

Kunna /progress don sake duba nasarar ka ko /start don sake yin jerin.
course_complete.yo:
🎉 Oriire! Ẹ ti parí gbogbo eko ati idinku!

Ẹ jẹ champion fun okunrin rere ati kawar GBV.

Kunna /progress lati yan awọ aseyọri rẹ tabi /start lati tun ṣe eko naa.
course_complete.ig:
🎉 Otú! Ị gachasịla akwukwo na ajụjụ nile!

Ị bụ ọchịchị maka dị mma na ikpirikpi GBV.

Biko kunna /progress iji lebanya ụnwụ gị ma /start iji ṣee akwukwo ọzọ.

not_started.en: It seems you haven't started the course yet. Type /start to begin!
not_started.pcm: E be like say you never start the course. Type /start to begin!
not_started.ha: Alama cewa ba ka fara jerin ba. Kunna /start don fara!
not_started.yo: O dipo pe ẹ ko ti bẹrẹ eko naa. Kunna /start lati bẹrẹ!
not_started.ig: Ọ dị ka ị megbeeru akwukwo ahụ. Kunna /start iji malite!

menu_continue.en: Type /next to continue from where you left off.
menu_continue.pcm: Type /next to continue from where you stop.
menu_continue.ha: Kunna /next don ci gaba daga inda ka bar.
menu_continue.yo: Kunna /next lati tẹsiwaju lati ibo ti ẹ ba le.
menu_continue.ig: Kunna /next iji gaa n'ihu site na ebe ị kwụsịrị.

language_changed.yo: Ede ti yi lọ si Yoruba! 🎉

friendly_nudge.en:
Hey brother! I'm here to guide you through the course. Use the buttons below or try these:

📖 /next — Continue your lesson
📝 /quiz — Take the module quiz
📊 /progress — See where you are
📚 /menu — View course outline

You can also ask me questions about the course content!
friendly_nudge.pcm:
How far brother! I dey here to guide you through the course. Use the buttons below or try these:

📖 /next — Continue your lesson
📝 /quiz — Do the quiz
📊 /progress — Check where you dey
📚 /menu — See course outline

You fit also ask me questions about the course!
friendly_nudge.ha:
Sannu brother! Ina nan don taimaka maka a cikin jerin. Yi amfani da batu a ƙasa ko gwada waɗannan:

📖 /next — Ci gaba da jerin
📝 /quiz — Yi quiz
📊 /progress — Dubi inda kake
📚 /menu — Dubi firafen jerin

Kana iya tambayar ni game da abin da ake koyarwa!
friendly_nudge.yo:
Hey brother! Mo wa nibi lati tọ ọ si eko naa. Lo awọn bọtini ni isalẹ tabi gbiyanju awọn wọnyi:

📖 /next — Tẹsiwaju eko rẹ
📝 /quiz — Ṣe idinku
📊 /progress — Wo ibi ti o wa
📚 /menu — Wo ọkọ eko

O le beere awọn ibeere nipa eko naa!
friendly_nudge.ig:
Hey brother! A nọ ebe a iji duzie gị na akwukwo. Jiri bọtini ndị dị n'okpuru ma ọ bụ nwaa ndị a:

📖 /next — Gaa n'ihu na akwukwo
📝 /quiz — Mee ajụjụ
📊 /progress — Lee ebe ị nọ
📚 /menu — Lee ụkpụrụ akwukwo

Ị nwekwara ike ịjụ m ajụjụ banyere akwukwo!
